_meta.notes: Comprehensive index for Marshall Islands covering Micronesian settlement (~2000 BCE), Austronesian stick chart navigation, Spanish claim (16th century), German protectorate (1885-1914), Japanese mandate (1914-1944), WWII (Battle of Kwajalein/Eniwetok), US Trust Territory (1947-1986), nuclear testing (1946-58, Bikini/Enewetak atolls, 67 tests including Castle Bravo largest US ever, nuclear legacy), Compact of Free Association 1986, independence, climate change existential threat.

country_profile.government_type: Unitary parliamentary republic in free association with the United States

religion.note: United Church of Christ (Congregational, American Board missionaries 1857, dominant); Assemblies of God; Catholic; LDS growing; church central to community (Sunday observance strict); traditional beliefs (Lowa creator) largely replaced but cultural practices survive

ethnic_groups.name: Marshallese
ethnic_groups.notes: Micronesian; Austronesian language; traditional stick chart navigation (unique, wave/swell patterns mapped on sticks, UNESCO intangible heritage); matrilineal land tenure (women control land inheritance, bwij clan system); iroij (chiefs, paramount/lesser, retained influence); atoll ecology (coconut/breadfruit/pandanus); nuclear testing survivors (radiation exposure, 'Jellyfish babies', thyroid cancer, displacement, intergenerational trauma)

ethnic_groups.name: Other Micronesian
ethnic_groups.notes: Kosraean, Chuukese (FSM citizens, labour migration); compact migrants between FAS nations

ethnic_groups.name: Other
ethnic_groups.notes: American (military, Kwajalein/Reagan Test Site, ~1,200 US personnel); Filipino; Chinese; mixed heritage; significant diaspora (~30k Marshallese in US, mainly Arkansas/Oklahoma/Hawaii, COFA allows free movement to US)

independence.from: US Trust Territory of the Pacific Islands (Compact of Free Association; full sovereignty but US handles defence, citizens can live/work in US)

country_profile.notes_unique: Nuclear testing ground (1946-1958, 67 US nuclear tests on Bikini and Enewetak atolls; Castle Bravo March 1, 1954 largest US test 15 megatons, 1000x Hiroshima, irradiated Rongelap atoll downwind, fallout on islanders, Japanese fishing boat Lucky Dragon #5; Bikini evacuated 1946 'for the good of mankind', residents never permanently returned; Bikini swimsuit named after atoll; Enewetak cleanup 1977-80 Runit Dome/Cactus Dome leaking radioactive waste; intergenerational health effects, birth defects, cancer, Nuclear Claims Tribunal awarded $2.3B but US paid only $150M); Compact of Free Association (COFA, 1986 with US, renewed 2023 for 20 years, $7.1B total, US military access/defence responsibility, Marshallese can live/work/study in US without visa, ~30k in US); Kwajalein Atoll (world's largest coral atoll by lagoon area, Ronald Reagan Ballistic Missile Defense Test Site, US Army, intercontinental missile testing, Ebeye 'slum of the Pacific' ~12k on 78 acres); climate change (average elevation 2m, existential, many islands submerging, some already relocated); stick chart navigation (unique Marshallese innovation, wave/swell patterns on coconut stick frameworks, each chart unique, UNESCO); flag ship registry (3rd largest in world by tonnage, Liberia/Panama/Marshall Islands, source of revenue); Majuro overcrowded (~27k); copra/fisheries economy; US strategic interest (Pacific pivot)

current_leader.name: Hilda Heine
current_leader.title: President
current_leader.notes: First female head of state of any Pacific island country (previously president 2016-2020 too); PhD education (first Marshallese woman with PhD); independent; nuclear justice advocate; climate champion; COFA renegotiation completion; strong international voice for small island developing states

former_leaders.name: David Kabua
former_leaders.notes: AKA; son of founding President Amata Kabua; iroij (chief); COFA renewal negotiations with US ($7.1B deal 2023); Taiwan recognition maintained; COVID response (kept virus out until 2022)

former_leaders.name: Hilda Heine (1st term)
former_leaders.notes: First female Pacific island head of state; nuclear justice; climate activism; lost 2020 to Kabua

former_leaders.name: Christopher Loeak
former_leaders.notes: Climate advocacy at UN; nuclear legacy compensation; Taiwan relations

former_leaders.name: Amata Kabua
former_leaders.notes: First president; iroij paramount chief; negotiated COFA; independence architect; died in office 1996; founding father; Kabua political dynasty
